name: Class Afloat (West Island College International)

geo.address: 97 Kaulbach Street, Lunenburg, NS B0J 2C0 (shore office; school operates aboard a tall ship)
geo.coord_source: Nova Scotia private-schools dataset georeference POINT (-64.31377 44.3799)

description: Sail-training boarding high school: students spend a semester or a full year at sea on a tall ship, earning Nova Scotia Grade 11–12 credits (and first-year university courses) while visiting ports worldwide. Recognized by Nova Scotia to grant the High School Leaving Certificate.

attributes.philosophy: Experiential, expedition-based learning: academics, seamanship and in-port/land programmes combined; social-responsibility and global education themes.

legal_status.label: Recognized private school granting the Nova Scotia High School Leaving Certificate (Education Act, N.S.)
legal_status.province_category: Recognized private school (not a designated special-education school)
legal_status.authority: Nova Scotia Department of Education and Early Childhood Development

attributes.grades: Grades 10–12 per provincial list; school site describes Grade 11–12 and first-year university courses
attributes.curriculum: Nova Scotia high-school courses at sea; first-year university courses.
attributes.qualifications_offered: Nova Scotia High School Leaving Certificate (graduation requirements of the N.S. Department of Education).
accreditation: Recognized by the N.S. Department of Education (renewal date 31 July 2027 in the provincial dataset)

tuition.notes: Full year CAD $82,000 or $86,200 and single semester CAD $55,800 or $58,700 — the site shows two price sets whose selection depends on the applicant's country (calculator not machine-readable). Includes room and board, programmes, accreditation fees, medical insurance, uniform and sailing gear.

attributes.additional_fees: Included items listed; airfare to ship not stated.
advantages: Unique experiential model with a recognised provincial certificate
Can be a one-semester experience inside another school pathway
limitations: Only senior high-school years; not a continuous schooling option
attributes.qualifying_reason: On Nova Scotia's list of recognized private schools granting the High School Leaving Certificate; experiential sail-training model confirmed on the official site; 2027-28 fees published (the year now being sold).
